class.description: Crospi robot driver for any robot with a ros2_control hardware interface. The hardware components of the robot description (URDF/xacro) are executed directly in the real-time thread of the driver (no controller_manager).

Crospi robot simulator for simulated ros2_control hardware (mock_components/GenericSystem, topic_based_ros2_control for Isaac Sim, ...). The hardware components of the robot description (URDF/xacro) are executed directly in the real-time thread of the driver (no controller_manager).
